accepted_patch_shape.name: page-bounded batch attempt recording with caught preamble failures
requirements: Do not rely on increasing llm.preflightTimeoutMs.
Break the score_gen attempt-start fanout into bounded pages so each preflight guard covers one page, not the full batch chunk.
Keep the preamble failure path inside processRunStageBatchChunk's catch boundary so it no longer escapes as a raw activity failure.
Preserve enough telemetry to diagnose pre-batch failure cause from process surfaces.

rejected_patch_shapes.name: increase llm.preflightTimeoutMs
rejected_patch_shapes.reason: Masks the symptom but keeps one large fanout and weakens the fast-fail guard globally.

rejected_patch_shapes.name: leave attempt recording monolithic and only improve logging
rejected_patch_shapes.reason: Improves diagnosis but does not remove the score_gen blocker.

notes: The discovered control-flow bug is that the record-attempt preflight guard lived outside the batch chunk try/catch.

The patch is acceptable without a brand-new Convex checkpoint table because recordLlmAttemptStart is already idempotent on attempt_key and the immediate blocker is the monolithic 60s preflight segment.
